name: page-transition-viewport
title: Page Transition Viewport
description: Wrap `{children}` in your root layout, pass `usePathname()` as `routeKey`, and outgoing routes are held in the DOM long enough to play their exit animation. Ships with a buttery push-pull (scale + blur + slide) and three other variants.
author: Wensity <hello@wensity.com>

theme.font-sans: var(--font-cabinet, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, Segoe UI, sans-serif)

docs: Free Wensity component. Installs to @components/wensity/page-transition-viewport.tsx. For Pro components and updates, use pnpm dlx wensity@latest add page-transition-viewport.
